phrases.phrase: The forum has no active Discord server, so there is nothing for a resync to run against. Ask a member of staff to check the forum's Discord server list.
The forum's Discord integration is missing its credentials, so a resync cannot run. Ask a member of staff to check them.
You do not have a Discord account linked, so there is nothing to resync. Reload the page to see your account as it stands now.
A resync updates your roles. It will not put you back into a Discord server you have left.
A Discord sync is already queued for your account.
Your Discord resync is queued. It will run when the queue gets to it.
Your Discord resync could not be queued. Nothing will run, so ask a member of staff to take a look.
Reconcile Discord roles against forum groups
